notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! ⭐
A huge thank you for trying out the demo and sharing your feedback!
We've made a ton of improvements recently, all thanks to your amazing support. 🙌

Bugs & Fixes:

 Fixed random crashes on laptops.
 Fixed black screen issue on older MacBooks.
 Fixed bug where a talking shape didn’t wake up a sleepy shape.
 Corrected French typos. Thanks to @Zedora_exe

Other:

 Improved cursor assist for controllers.
 Visual update to the bookmark indicator.

If you come across any more bugs or have any feedback, feel free to share it in this post. We really appreciate your help!

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you soon! ✨
